artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan: rule first (branch topology, landing strategy, no worktree reinstatement) in phases 1-2, then build the milestone review ref by git ref plumbing, the pre-completion landing verification, and the consent-gated push/review handoff in phases 3-7.

memory_candidates.content: When authoring a plan phase's **Tier Justification** line, never spell out the phase's touched paths inline if any of them is a scripts/tests/test-*.sh file. validate-artifact.sh's Tier-Justification measurement check extracts every test-*.sh token on that line and compares the set against suite_selection_select's actual output, so a path list naming a not-yet-created suite warns twice ('fabricates coverage' for the new suite, 'under-verifies' for the 30+ suites the real selector returns). The clean, warning-free shape names only the entry point and points at the field: 'bash <source_store>/scripts/verify-touched.sh, invoked over this phase's Files to modify paths, resolves them to their covering suites and runs that narrowed pass -- <what it covers>.'
